Generated Narrative: Requirements SGAuthoring.Skills.ScopeDAK

Profile: SMART Guidelines Requirements

These requirements apply to the actor Programme Manager

Define DAK purpose and target audienceSHALL

Can articulate the purpose of the DAK, identify the target audience, assess whether similar publications exist, and define the gaps the DAK will address.

Establish development processSHALL

Can establish the development process and governance to be used, including selection of agile methodology and determination of ownership and key stakeholders.

Determine project toolingSHALL

Can determine the tools to be used for project tracking, communication, and DAK components design (e.g. BPMN tooling).

Assess resource requirementsSHALL

Can assess the necessary resources to develop the DAK, including securing adequate budget for each step of the process.

Gather source documentsSHALL

Can gather and catalogue source documents including normative products, policy documents, paper registers, tally sheets, and reporting tools.
